children: HDFC Bank Limited Sponsored ADR (NSE:HDFCBANK) reported resilient Q1 results and Moody’s Baa3 backing for GIFT City notes, even as it faces a class-action suit over alleged MSRDC payments, leadership succession decisions, governance reviews after ex-chairman Atanu Chakraborty’s exit, and a planned NCLAT appeal.
HDFC Bank Limited Sponsored ADR Accuses Executives
: Class-action suit filed Aug 13, 2026 in SDNY names HDFC Bank ADR (HDFCBANK) and two executives over alleged ₹45 crore MSRDC payments tied to deposit inducements; bank says claims meritless.
: HDFC Bank ADR (HDFCBANK) Q1 consolidated net profit Rs19,060cr (+5% YoY); net interest income Rs33,534cr (+7%); NIM 3.26%; GNPA 1.17% of advances.
: HDFC Bank ADR (HDFCBANK) is assessing successors to CEO Jagdishan. Internal candidates include DMD Kaizad Bharucha and V. Srinivasa Rangan. RBI tenure rules and approval will shape any appointment.
: Moody’s rated HDFC Bank Sponsored ADR (HDFCBANK) Baa3 with stable outlook for GIFT City branch USD senior unsecured notes maturing 2029 and 2031, matching the bank’s long-term deposit rating.
: HDFC Bank ADR (HDFCBANK) saw ex-chairman Atanu Chakraborty resign in 2026. The bank ordered two external law-firm reviews on governance; the bank later said the reviews cleared the matter.
: HDFC Bank ADR (HDFCBANK) opposed NCLT‑approved repayment plan for Subhash Chandra, citing only ~0.03% recovery on ₹22,006.57 crore claims; bank plans to appeal to NCLAT.
